designationHistory.name: Back Bay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Back Bay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7907; it is now Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7907—Establishing the Back Bay Migratory Waterfowl Refuge (Jun 06, 1938)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1938 to protect and provide habitat for migratory and wintering waterfowl, or ducks, geese and swans.
